blocks.x: The Forbidden Forest is back in Westchester, but this time, it’s bringing a whole new enchanting adventure! Whether you enjoyed the original trail four years ago or you’re stepping into the Wizarding World for the first time, Harry Potter: A Forbidden Forest Experience is returning with new spellbinding surprises, unseen magical creatures, and even more interactive moments to discover. The enchanting trail returns to FDR State Park in Westchester, starting October 16, just 40 miles from NYC.
Here’s what awaits inside Harry Potter’s Forbidden Forest in Westchester

Harry Potter’s Forbidden Forest Experience
Prepare to step back into the enchantment, follow the illuminated forest path, and see what awaits you among the trees. Tickets are expected to go fast, grab yours here!

Harry Potter’s Forbidden Forest Experience
Along the way, you can cast your own spells, encounter enchanting creatures like the majestic Hippogriff, Nifflers and Centaurs, spot giant spiders hanging among the trees, and even catch a glimpse of Hagrid among his pumpkins. It’s a chance to discover the Wizarding World and experience the thrill all over again.

There’s something special about experiencing this world under a canopy of trees and a night sky… especially with how magical fall feels in Westchester. Watch luminous lights flicker through the forest, see familiar creatures and wizarding details come to life around you, and get the chance to enjoy delicious treats and sip Butterbeer. For longtime Harry Potter fans, it’s a chance to reconnect with the beloved franchise in a completely different setting. And since the experience is only here for a limited time, you’ll want to grab your spot while you can.

If you’ve ever wished you could experience the Wizarding World beyond the pages and screen, this is your chance to do it under the stars. More than 2 million people across four continents and 16 cities have already ventured into the Forbidden Forest, and now the experience is returning to New York, better than ever. Consider this your sign to see what all the enchantment is about.
Head to Westchester and step into the Forbidden Forest, where even Muggles can experience a little wonder this fall.
The Harry Potter: Forbidden Forest Experience has received 5-star reviews from visitors who have checked it out in other cities across the world. See why they’re raving about it!

Joanna R. .– ”This was a magical experience that my entire family enjoyed! Such spectacular lighting and sound – we were transported! An added bonus was the fact that all of the staff were extremely nice!
Itza V.– “Worth every dollar, such an amazing experience and my fiancé loved every part. It’s even more fun in the dark when the lights make the forest even more thrilling. I would recommend 10/10.”
Lizze K. – “So well done! Worth the money and the drive. The Forbidden Forest will not be easily beaten.”

Ryan S. – “​​We had a great time. The music and effects were awesome. It is not too long so take your time and enjoy. Few interactive attractions for the kids. Definitely did them as well. A few of the staged moments are epic. Perfect for any true Harry Potter fan.”
Harry Potter: A Forbidden Forest Experience

When: October 16, 2026 – January 3, 2027
Duration: 60–90 minutes
Where: FDR State Park, 2957 Crompond Rd, Yorktown Heights, NY 10598
Parking: $15 when booked online, $20 onsite
Ages: All ages; kids under 3 enter free!
Accessibility: Woodland trail with mostly unpaved paths; motorized scooters available to rent at the entrance
Get your tickets now!
Don’t just see it all over social media. Stroll through the enchantment in real life. Get your tickets to step into the Forbidden Forest Experience in Westchester this October.
